description: One-DGX Spark Tencent Hy4 flash in Baekpica's mixed-precision GGUF (Q5/Q4 experts, Q8_0 dense projections, FP8 Engram tables read from SSD) on Baekpica's ds4-dfm-rs, the Rust-host continuation of DwarfStar (antirez ds4), built from the engine commit the creator names (25bf4b8f, the head of an open upstream pull request, pinned by full sha). MTP drafting with the DFly2 Q8_0 head at depth 2, native 1,048,576-token context, one request at a time, KV snapshots on local disk (16 GiB), text and image input through the BF16 projector. The Engram tables are read with O_DIRECT; the sandbox blocks io_uring, so the engine falls back to serial page reads and Engram prefill reads are slower than the creator's. The KV cache directory maps the creator's ~/.cache to the platform's writable cache. Creator figures (about 1,170 tok/s prefill and 21 tok/s decode over 2K-64K on GB10) are the creator's claims.
title: Hy4 flash MQ-Q5-Q8 ds4-dfm-rs single Spark (Baekpica)
